deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by @pranay for model enable 'harbor-13b-v2' in EU on 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Canary plan: 5% -> 20% -> 60% with 10m cooldowns. Preflight checks passed. /release/3344556677 :white_check_mark:
pranay: kicking off canary in eu-west1 at 02:00 UTC. Route overrides: /chat -> harbor-13b-v2-canary. Fallback chain set: harbor-13b-v2-q8 -> harbor-7b-v2 -> comet7b-quant. Cooldown between steps = 10m. Telemetry gating: drift-detector + SLO monitors enabled.
micah: adding quick guardrail: per-route heatmap for p50/p95 token-latency and a hard p95 guard = 3x baseline. If breached, pause and revert to pinned v7b. Example monitor rule:
```
metric: catalog.response.p95
condition: > baseline * 3 for 5m
action: pause-rollout + notify #incidents
```
anya: confirming rollout notes: pin list for EU-prod: harbor-7b-v2 pinned at 10% cold-standby. Harbor-13b-v2 will be unpinned after 2h stable. Rollback trigger: error_rate > 1.5% sustained for 15m OR coherence-drift > 0.08.
devex-bot: Reminder: update SDK docs and release page with new alias `harbor-13b-v2-stable`. Note: embedding normalization differs between q8 and full-precision, call out in CHANGELOG.
jordan: ops note — during staged increase throttle additional 10 req/s per route and cap batch_size=16 to avoid OOM spikes on small GPU shapes. Also set connection drain 30s on switchover.
sre-oncall: set alert playbook to runbook #22 (model degradation rollback). Pager threshold = incident_score >= 3. Also enabled quick short-circuit: when capacity pressure detected run fallback ordering immediate.
pranay: quick status: canary deployed to 3 hosts, processed initial ~10k tokens, no regen errors. If telemetry stays green, plan to bump to 20% at 02:40 UTC then check at 03:00 UTC.
micah: ack. Add manual gate: if top-k coherence drift > 0.08 trigger manual rollback.
deploy-bot: Canary metrics snapshot @02:30 UTC: p50=120ms (+10%), p95=560ms (+20%), error_rate=0.4% -> Canary PASS. Scheduling bump to 20% at 02:40 UTC. Next automated check at 03:00 UTC.
anya: tagging @emily-cs to notify customer success for latency-sensitive accounts in EU.
emily-cs: Thanks — I'll signal customers in the 02:00-04:00 window and share the release note link.
pranay: update @everyone: at 02:55 saw transient GPU memory spike on one canary host, one request evicted and routed to q8 fallback. Root cause: kernel scheduling preemption; patched on host and repro added. No user-facing errors. Continuing rollout.
micah: nice catch. I lowered eviction threshold to 85% mem on canary fleet to reduce noisy evictions.
deploy-bot: Rollout progress: harbor-13b-v2 set to 60% in EU at 03:20 UTC, stable alias `harbor-13b-v2-stable` created. Pinning harbor-7b-v2 to 10% as cold standby. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/3344556677 — mark for ops postmortem if any follow-ups. :ship:
